replies.author: TooSweetSki
replies.body:
Lifeboat never wanted to save OCN.
They bought OCN and took over (as they should), it's just that it took a while for it to happen, which gave the false pretense that OCN at its core would stick around as is.

But meh, nothing anyone can do now. PGM is closing and Hampton will take over..rip

replies.body:
Lifeboat isn't closing again as you said. PGM is closing, Hampton will probably save the server, It depends on whether they want to save it or not. We'll see.
